text: Welcome.
These few minutes are for letting stress leave your body.
Toward the end, I'll give you a few words to say to yourself.
Find a position where you can rest.
Lying down is welcome.
Let your eyes close, if that feels comfortable.
Feel the weight of your body right now.
The places where you're being held.
Breathe in through the nose.
And let it go.
Notice any places where you're holding tension.
Your jaw. Your shoulders. Your hands.
Notice it, and then let it soften on the next exhale.
Your nervous system is always listening.
And right now, you're telling it something important.
That it's safe to slow down.
With each exhale, your body softens a little more.
Now think of the stress you've been carrying today.
You don't have to name it.
Just feel where it sits in your body.
And let it leave with the next exhale.
Out through your hands.
Out through your feet.
Let it go somewhere far away.
Somewhere it can no longer reach your life.
You don't need to follow it.
A quiet warmth beginning to spread through your chest.
Your body has been waiting for permission.
So let it have this moment.
Now say this to yourself, silently.
I am safe to slow down.
Once more.
There is time.
You have time.
One more breath. Slow and easy.
When you're ready, let a little movement come back into your hands.
Open your eyes, and let your body keep this quiet.
